300: of Hebrew origin (אָמוֹן); Amon, an Israelite:--Amon.
301: of Hebrew origin (אָמוֹץ); Amos, an Israelite:--Amos.
302: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty:--(what-, where-, wither-, who-)soever. Usually unexpressed except by the subjunctive or potential mood. Also contracted for ἐάν.
303: a primary preposition and adverb; properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.):--and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through. In compounds (as a prefix) it often means (by implication) repetition, intensity, reversal, etc.
305: from ἀνά and the base of βάσις; to go up (literally or figuratively):--arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up).
306: middle voice from ἀνά and βάλλω; to put off (for oneself):--defer.
307: from ἀνά and a derivative of the base of βάσις; to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net):--draw.
308: from ἀνά and βλέπω; to look up; by implication, to recover sight:--look (up), see, receive sight.
309: from ἀναβλέπω; restoration of sight:--recovery of sight.
310: from ἀνά and βοάω; to halloo:--cry (aloud, out).
312: from ἀνά and the base of ἄγγελος; to announce (in detail):--declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell.
313: from ἀνά and γεννάω; to beget or (by extension) bear (again):--beget, (bear) X (again).
314: from ἀνά and γινώσκω; to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read:--read.
316: from ἀνάγκη; necessary; by implication, close (of kin):--near, necessary, necessity, needful.
317: adverb from a derivative of ἀναγκάζω; compulsorily:--by constraint.
318: from ἀνά and the base of ἀγκάλη; constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress:--distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful.
319: middle voice from ἀνά and γνωρίζω; to make (oneself) known:--be made known.
321: from ἀνά and ἄγω; to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away:--bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up.
322: from ἀνά and δεικνύω; to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint:--appoint, shew.
324: from ἀνά and δέχομαι; to entertain (as a guest):--receive.
325: from ἀνά and δίδωμι; to hand over:--deliver.
326: from ἀνά and ζάω; to recover life (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)live again, revive.
327: from ἀνά and ζητέω; to search out:--seek.
328: from ἀνά and ζώννυμι; to gird afresh:--gird up.
329: from ἀνά and a compound of the base of ζῶον and πῦρ; to re-enkindle:--stir up.
330: from ἀνά and (to flourish); to revive:--flourish again.
331: from ἀνατίθεμαι; a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person):--accused, anathema, curse, X great.
332: from ἀνάθεμα; to declare or vow under penalty of execration:--(bind under a) curse, bind with an oath.
333: from ἀνά and θεωρέω; to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively):--behold, consider.
334: from ἀνατίθεμαι (like ἀνάθεμα, but in a good sense); a votive offering:--gift.
335: from a compound of Α (as a negative particle (compare ἄνευ)) and αἰδώς; impudence, i.e. (by implication) importunity:--importunity.
337: from ἀνά and (the active of) αἱρέομαι; to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder:--put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up.
338: from Α (as a negative particle) and αἴτιος (in the sense of αἰτία); innocent:--blameless, guiltless.
339: from ἀνά and καθίζω; properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up:--sit up.
340: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός; to restore:--renew.
341: from ἀνά and a derivative of καινός; to renovate:--renew.
343: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and καλύπτω; to unveil:--open, (un-)taken away.
344: from ἀνά and κάμπτω; to turn back:--(re-)turn.
345: from ἀνά and κεῖμαι; to recline (as a corpse or at a meal):--guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table.
346: from ἀνά and κεφαλαιόω (in its original sense); to sum up:--briefly comprehend, gather together in one.
347: from ἀνά and κλίνω; to lean back:--lay, (make) sit down.
348: from ἀνά and κόπτω; to beat back, i.e. check:--hinder.
349: from ἀνά and κράζω; to scream up (aloud):--cry out.
350: from ἀνά and κρίνω; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine:--ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search.
352: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and κύπτω; to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated:--lift up, look up.
353: from ἀνά and λαμβάνω; to take up:--receive up, take (in, unto, up).
355: from ἀνά and a form of the alternate of αἱρέομαι; properly, to use up, i.e. destroy:--consume.
356: from a compound of ἀνά and λόγος; proportion:--proportion.
357: middle voice from ἀναλογία; to estimate, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:--consider.
358: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἅλς; saltless, i.e. insipid:--X lose saltness.
360: from ἀνά and λύω; to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively):--depart, return.
361: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἁμαρτάνω; sinless:--that is without sin.
362: from ἀνά and μένω; to await:--wait for.
363: from ἀνά and μιμνήσκω; to remind; (reflexively) to recollect:--call to mind, (bring to , call to, put in), remember(-brance).
365: from ἀνά and a derivative of νέος; to renovate, i.e. reform:--renew.
366: from ἀνά and νήφω; to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses:--recover self.
367: of Hebrew origin (חֲנַנְיָה); Ananias, the name of three Israelites:--Ananias.
368: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of ἀντί and ῥέω; indisputable:--cannot be spoken against.
370: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἄξιος; unfit:--unworthy.
372: from ἀναπαύω; intermission; by implication, recreation:--rest.
373: from ἀνά and παύω; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh:--take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.
374: from ἀνά and πείθω; to incite:--persuade.
375: from ἀνά and πέμπω; to send up or back:--send (again).
376: from ἀνά (in the sense of intensity) and (maimed); crippled:--maimed.
377: from ἀνά and πίπτω; to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back:--lean, sit down (to meat).
378: from ἀνά and πληρόω; to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience):--fill up, fulfill, occupy, supply.
379: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of ἀπολογέομαι; indefensible:--without an excuse, inexcusable.
380: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and πτύσσω; to unroll (a scroll or volume):--open.
381: from ἀνά and ἅπτω; to enkindle:--kindle, light.
382: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of ἀριθμέω; unnumbered, i.e. without number:--innumerable.
383: from ἀνά and σείω; figuratively, to excite:--move, stir up.
384: from ἀνά (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of σκεῦος; properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset:--subvert.
385: from ἀνά and σπάω; to take up or extricate:--draw up, pull out.
386: from ἀνίστημι; a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth):--raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.
387: from a derivative of ἀνίστημι (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively):--trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.
388: from ἀνά and σταυρόω; to recrucify (figuratively):--crucify afresh.
389: from ἀνά and στενάζω; to sigh deeply:--sigh deeply.
390: from ἀνά and στρέφω; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live:--abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.
392: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τάσσω; to arrange:--set in order.
393: from ἀνά and the base of τέλος; to (cause to) arise:--(a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.
394: from ἀνά and the middle voice of τίθημι; to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound:--communicate, declare.
395: from ἀνατέλλω; a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural):--dayspring, east, rising.
396: from ἀνά and the base of τροπή; to overturn (figuratively):--overthrow, subvert.
397: from ἀνά and τρέφω; to rear (physically or mentally):--bring up, nourish (up).
398: from ἀνά and φαίνω; to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out:--(should) appear, discover.
399: from ἀνά and φέρω; to take up (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).
